company.description: FUSE AE is a Dubai-based electric mobility and clean transportation technology company specializing in converting traditional petrol and diesel vehicles into electric vehicles (EVs). The company develops custom EV powertrains, battery systems, fleet retrofit solutions, and electric mobility technologies designed for commercial fleets, industrial vehicles, off-road platforms, and classic cars.
